sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-07 and 2016-12-07, account C02923 on card C02923-K1 was subjected to unauthorized fraudulent activity consistent with account takeover. A total of 2 transaction(s) were flagged, representing an aggregate exposure of $117.07 USD. Investigation uncovered common infrastructure links to connected card(s) C08374-K1, C03019-K2, C11000-K2, C07212-K1, C01864-K1, C11513-K1, C08605-K1, C02716-K1, C04108-K2, C09149-K1, C11143-K1, C09800-K1, C02231-K1, C09241-K2, C00854-K2, C04125-K1, C06224-K2, C01155-K2, C05560-K2, C05704-K2, C01755-K2, C12897-K1, C10308-K1, C03040-K2, C00750-K2, C00820-K1. Customer was contacted and reported: 'Customer denied the transaction when asked'. The pattern of unauthorized transactions diverges significantly from cardholder historical profile. Based on regulatory guidelines under FinCEN and bank fraud policy R2/R6, the card has been blocked and reissued, connected entities placed under heightened monitoring, and this report is submitted to document the illicit financial activity.
